name: Roger
long_description:
💼 Augment builds AI-powered tools to automate company operations, starting with Roger—an intelligent CRM that acts as your AI-powered sales team. 💼

🚀 Built by experienced founders and backed by Y Combinator, Augment is redefining sales automation with AI-driven workflows that handle prospecting, outreach, and deal management—so businesses can scale effortlessly.

How it Works – 

Roger, Your AI-Powered CRM

📊 A CRM That Works for You

Unlike traditional CRMs that require constant manual updates, Roger actively manages your sales pipeline. It tracks interactions, follows up with leads, and keeps your team focused on closing deals instead of admin work.

🤖 AI-Powered Outreach & Engagement

Roger automates lead generation and crafts personalized outreach messages across email, LinkedIn, and other channels. It continuously refines its approach based on engagement data to increase conversions.

🎯 Smart Deal Management

Roger qualifies leads, schedules follow-ups, and moves deals through your pipeline automatically. It ensures your team never drops the ball on a potential customer.

📈 Seamless Integration & Insights

Roger syncs with your existing tools, updating your sales data in real-time. AI-powered analytics provide actionable insights, helping teams optimize sales strategies. By automating tedious sales tasks and making CRM proactive instead of passive, Roger turns AI into your most efficient sales teammate—helping businesses close more deals, faster.
one_liner: Roger is an AI SDR that automates outbound sales and follows up 24/7.

launches.tagline: Autonomous agents that research and sell your product 24/7.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** ClawGTM turns your website URL into an autonomous sales force. Our OpenClaw agents identify your best-fit leads, perform deep contextual research, and start conversations on Email and LinkedIn, all in under 60 seconds.

### **The Problem**

Most founders and sales teams are stuck in a manual loop. You spend hours hunting for leads and stalking LinkedIn profiles, only to send "personalized" emails that still feel like templates.

Existing "AI SDRs" have made this worse. They've flooded inboxes with generic, robotic spam that prospects have learned to ignore. If your outreach doesn't have **real reasoning** behind it, it’s going straight to the bin.

### **Meet ClawGTM: Your Autonomous GTM Engine**

ClawGTM doesn't just "automate" emails; it **deploys intelligence**. Built on the viral OpenClaw framework, our agents perform the heavy lifting of a full sales team:

* **Website as a Prompt:** Paste your URL. The agent reads your site to understand your core value prop and target audience.
* **Hyper-Detailed ICP Filtering:** The agent performs deep, multi-layered filtering to find prospects in specific niches that traditional tools miss.
* **Job-Based Intelligence:** The agent monitors **hiring patterns** and **leadership changes** to infer what a company is dealing with. If they are hiring for "Postgres DBA" or "Compliance Officer," the agent identifies the specific tools they use and the internal hurdles they are currently facing.
* **Multi-Channel Execution:** Once the niche is identified, it coordinates across Email and LinkedIn with 1-of-1 messaging that reflects your product's specific value.

### **Start Today**

Ready to stop "doing" sales and start deploying agents?

* **Try it now:** <https://clawgtm.com>
* **Email us:** rithwik@hireroger.com
* **Text us:** +1 (469) 328-3769

**You build the product. We’ll find the people who need it.**

launches.tagline: Let Roger handle your outbound. It finds leads, personalizes messages, and fills your calendar automatically.
launches.body:
Tired of outbound tools that just _send emails_? Roger goes way further.

Roger is your AI sales rep: it finds leads, understands what they care about, and messages them across email + LinkedIn to book meetings. Fully automated, deeply personalized.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91648&key=user_uploads/1843987/3a7cc9ac-e768-4954-be4e-57194f4912f5)

⚡ \*\*Set it up once. Then forget it.\*\*\
Founders call Roger their “money printer” because it runs in the background, filling their calendar while they work on product.

🔍 **How it works:**

**1. Finds leads**\
Roger deploys agent swarms across 300M profiles, live job listings, and even custom scrapers to turn raw data into targeted prospects.

**2. Understands context**\
It reads company descriptions, roles, and products to deeply understand what each lead actually needs.

**3. Reaches out smartly**\
Then Roger crafts personalized messages across email and LinkedIn: like a top-performing SDR, but automated.

**4. Books meetings**\
Qualified leads get booked straight into your calendar. No chasing. No manual work.

🏆 YC founders, agency owners, and SaaS startups are using Roger to turn cold outreach into warm intros, without lifting a finger.

launches.title: CardLift - Achieve top-of-wallet status for your credit card program
launches.tagline: CardLift builds co-branded browser extensions to help credit card issuers maximize their share of wallet
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

[CardLift](https://withcardlift.com) builds co-branded browser extensions to help credit card issuers maximize their share of wallet (and, in turn, per-user revenue).

### How It Works

We build your credit card program a co-branded browser extension. When a user signs up for your card, you can incentivize them to add your extension to their browser. Your users are now 2 - 4x more valuable.

**Migrate Existing Spend**

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=82885&key=user_uploads/1843987/39dd468e-f9db-4e37-99de-e26e987eb907)

When your credit card program onboards a new user, we make it dead simple for them to switch their card-on-file at all of their top online merchants to your card with one click.

Our AI-powered browser extension not only automatically detects where your users spend the most (Netflix, Amazon, T-mobile, Progressive), but also lets them switch out their primary payment method to your card with one click. Users press a button in their browser, and their card-on-file everywhere instantly switches to their shiny new card (your card!).

Offer your users an incentive to make this switch, and watch your per-user GMV transaction volume skyrocket even more.

**Ensure You Continue To Capture Future Spend**

We don’t just help when a user signs up to your card program. Our fast checkout technology embeds “One Tap Checkout ” on the checkout page at over 50,000 e-commerce sites - making your card the easiest way for users to complete any transaction on their browser.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=82885&key=user_uploads/1843987/3b3cd133-188f-4cc5-ae83-acc536f9a3af)

You can even customize the copy to tell the user why to use your card for that specific purchase. For example, if you were Chase, you could prompt your users to use their Sapphire Preferred card on Avis BECAUSE it offers car rental insurance.

**Make Your Card Program More Rewarding**

For the final cherry on top, we partner with over 1,000 of the country’s top merchants to offer additional affiliate-based cash back that you can add to your existing cashback. Your users can now earn double or even triple the cash back on Sephora when they use your “One Tap Checkout” button instead of their other cards.

**Full Demo** - [**https://cardvaultco.com/demo**](https://cardvaultco.com/demo)

### About Us

CardLift is founded by Rithwik Pattikonda - serial browser extension entrepreneur who has built some of the world’s largest browser extensions - OctoShop (acquired by NYSE:IBTA) and TravelArrow (300,000+ users). At CardLift, his goal is to bring some of the learnings and insights from his previous consumer browser extensions to financial institutions.
